turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My storage is full again and I can't even take a picture.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Annoying. Do you want to pay for cloud storage, or clear things out by hand?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hmm, both sound kind of bad.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: They each have a cost, time or money. Which one would you rather spend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on a minute, I want to ask Leo something first. Don't jump in until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Leo, are you eating with us tonight or are you going out?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I'm staying in. What are you making?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll be back in five, don't start the movie without me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Some kind of stir fry, I haven't fully decided. Do you eat mushrooms now?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Only if they're cooked properly, not the slimy kind.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine, I'll fry them hard on high heat then.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Perfect. I'll do the dishes after, deal?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi again. So, for your full storage, are you paying for the cloud or clearing it by hand?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll pay for the cloud. My time is worth more.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fair enough. The smallest paid plan is usually enough, and once photos upload you can remove them from the phone.
